title: PR #203: docs(architecture): add versioned Aurora ecosystem technical spec
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Summary
Adds `docs/architecture/AURORA_ECOSYSTEM_TECHNICAL_SPEC_V1.md` as a versioned draft supplement to the existing system architecture.

The specification defines:
- L0–L7 responsibility domains and cross-layer Control Plane X;
- trust boundaries and authority invariants;
- proposed contracts for agent identity, compute jobs, attestations, policy decisions and blockchain transaction flow;
- a repository evidence snapshot with exact observed default-branch HEAD SHAs and conservative IMPLEMENTED/OPEN distinctions;
- prioritized implementation work packages, acceptance criteria and open decisions.

## Evidence and limitations
- Evidence snapshot: 2026-10-18.
- The cited SHAs are observed default-branch heads, not claims that CI/E2E passed for them.
- IMPLEMENTED describes the existence of a cited artifact only; VERIFIED requires an exact-SHA test/run reference.
- The document explicitly does not claim a production-ready, fully integrated decentralized AI/compute path.

## Review requested
Please review the normative boundary rules, contract fields, evidence status semantics and open decisions. Required implementation work is intentionally separated into issues. No merge or production-readiness claim is made by this PR.
